verdict.rationale: Google ADK is itself an official, code-first agent development SDK. It ships in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin, with an official google/adk-python repo, documented Agent APIs and code samples, and an `adk` CLI for running, evaluating, and deploying agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and detailed evidence for the non-Python language SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin.
Code-First Development: Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning.
Create your first Python ADK agent in minutes.
